Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent incorrectly identified the director of the 1972 film "Mirage" as Edward Dmytryk in its initial response. The search results clearly displayed "Mirage (1972) - Directed by Armando Robles Godoy" in the visible text and metadata, but the agent ignored this explicit information and hallucinated a different director. This fundamental error in entity recognition led to the entire subsequent investigation being based on the wrong person, causing the Planner to waste multiple steps searching for the father of the wrong individual before the correct director was eventually identified in later steps.
